brief: Bring forward the detailed inspection for Langmere Common 230/34kV ahead of the forecast heat event, as its maintenance interval is overdue and its cooling system is unverified. If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified.
